problem_statement: Calling fs_stat() on a mount point path (for example the root of a mounted volume, such as "/SDCD:") does not succeed. Instead of recognising the path as a directory at the VFS level, the call is handed to the underlying filesystem's stat implementation, which may not be implemented at all (in which case the call fails with an error) or may fail. By contrast fs_readdir() already treats mount points as directories. A stat on a mount point should succeed and report it as a directory, with its name and type filled in, the same way a stat of an ordinary directory succeeds.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/subsys/fs/fs_api -s tests/subsys/fs/fs_api/filesystem.api -s filesystem.api -O twister-out --no-clean -W
